record.question:
Rewrite the following sentences as directed: (10x1=10)
(a) Suresh thought of a new play. (change the voice)
(b) She complained that the room was hot. (make a simple sentence)
(c) He is sometimes foolish. (change into negative form)
(d) This sum is too difficult for me to solve. (make a complex sentence)
(e) Whata piece of work is man! (change into assertive sentence)
(f) Itis no use blaming him. (begin the sentence with ‘there’)
(g) Gold jewellery is bought and sold here. (change the voice)
(h) ‘Call the first witness’, said the judge. (change into indirect speech)
() Although she is glamorous, she is modest. (use ‘as’ in the sentence)
(j) He requested them to wait there till he returned. (change into direct speech)
